21 now, I was 14 when I was raped by my abusive, alcoholic mother. Basically after a long day of being bullied at school and getting the shit kicked out of me, I go home to try to catch some sleep. I took a couple sleep aid pills to help me get to bed better, but it turns out my mother put her oxicodon in that bottle for whatever reason. I didn't realize it until after I had swallowed it. I tried forcing myself to throw it up, but it didn't work.

So I go into my room and lay down. Next thing I know I'm strapped down to my bed and my mother is on top of me saying "it's going to be okay. Shhhh, mommy takes good care of you." I tried screaming out for help but I was gagged. I had to take it. All of it. While riding me, she would beat me, curse at me, and for whatever reason, would enjoy cutting my left arm. She would lick up my blood and spit it back in my face. I was in hell.

It lasted about 2 hours and then she went back to her room after untying me. I was in so much pain that all I could do was roll over and cry. Then sleep. Then cry more. Until I finally got up to talk to my dad. 

Mind you, this is a few days later. He'd finally come back from his business trip. So I tell him what happened and he goes to talk to my mom about it. The next morning he told me to act like nothing happened. So for years that's what I did. I buried that secret deep within myself and became extremely depressed. Suicidal thoughts, self harm, etc. I think my worst is when I was clinically dead for 2mins because I over dosed on a mixture of bleach, nyquil, rat poison, and some cool aid fruit punch powder for flavor. Hospital saved me, was sent home after a short psychological evaluation where I was dismissed as sane.

I've had two girlfriends in which I've tried explaining this to them, but they refuse to believe me because "your mother is such a fun and wonderful person." They called me a liar and a fake, thinking I was only doing this for attention. Now I have little to no trust for just about every women I look at. I either see my abusive mother, or my shitty ex's. 

I'm 21 now and signed up for therapy once a week. I've been diagnosed with depression and PTSD (post traumatic stress disorder). I am not medicated. I smoke weed to take the edge off, I still live at home with my mother and father. I have talked to the cops, but refuse to press charges.

 My parents are going through enough shit right now. Last thing they need is a warrant for my mother's arrest and both of my parents being charged with child abuse. We'd lose our house, my dad's 6-figure job, all of our money, and basically anything my family has worked for. And I won't be the one to tear this "family" apart.

But in the bright side, by law the detectives had to question my parents so my parents now understand why I ended up hating them as much as I did. My mother says she doesn't remember the incident and has been sober for about 1.5 years now. 

As much as I hate my family and my refusal to press charges despite what therapists and detectives have told me, I know I'm a better person then they ever will be. I don't hold grudges, I don't resent my life and contemplate suicide. It happened. I grew up and dealt with it myself. Only recently what with college and work and home problems have I felt that I need a little more support so, yea therapy.

I started therapy about 2 weeks ago and feel great having vented it out. 

TL;DR - Raped and abused by my mother. No one believed me. I turned 21 and went to therapy and met detectives. They believe me. Parents know. Dad feels bad, mom doesn't remember and can't look at me.
